basic_info.description: Are you looking for something special, full of character and charm? You just found it! This is a beautiful Arts and Crafts home full of charm and unique details in coveted Potrero Hill. It features 2 bedrooms, bathroom with clawfoot tub and vintage sink, and an open floor plan with stained glass and natural wood detailing throughout. This is a truly delightful home flooded with light - You will love spending time in the park-like backyard and will enjoy the views during the day and the sunsets at dusk. You will also find lots of storage in this home, and it is very conveniently located, just steps from the bus stop, close to freeways, hospital, shops and restaurants in Potrero as well as the Mission.  It also offers expansion and development potential so bring your creativity and love of nature. It's a must see!
